Rainwood Village — Help

everything you can do in the village — now with over 100 houses, four bridges and a town square

🌾 Farming

Find the big field south of the market. Till a plot (E), plant seeds (buy wheat, carrot & pumpkin seeds at the market — pumpkins grow slowest, sell best), water it with a bucket from the well or river, wait for it to grow, then harvest.

Tip: rent the tractor 🚜 and it tills & harvests plots as you drive over them. The bike 🚲 is the cheapest way to explore — and yes, you can cycle over all four bridges. Watch for villagers driving cars, bikes and tractors!

🏗️ Build a house

Chop trees for wood and deposit it at the build site west of the bridge (12 wood). The truck 🛻 parked near the trees auto-loads your timber — unload it all at the site. Finished houses stay in the village forever.

🌹 Dating

Boys pick a rose and give it to a girl to ask for a date. She accepts → you're a couple 💞 — hearts, a jingle, and the Sweetheart challenge await.

🏛️ The village square

West of the river sits the Town Hall — read its notice board 📋 to open the challenge list. Next door are the little Museum (read every plaque!), the Gallery (the paintings are made in the village) and the Village Office. All of them are open — walk right in.

🚜 Vehicles

At Miller's Barn (north-west path) rent a tractor, a car or a truck for coins. Drive with WASD / joystick, E steps out. Return them at the barn or they head home when time's up.

🚂 The train

The little train shuttles between Rainwood Station (east side) and Meadow Halt (far north). When it waits at a platform, walk up and hop on — ride across the village and hop off at the other stop.

🫐 Foraging & animals

Pick berries, draw water, chop trees, pick roses, and feed the hens, the cat and the deer (they love berries). Everything respawns after a while.

🛒 Market

Sell berries, wood, water, crops and roses for coins; buy seeds and roses. Coins rent vehicles and claim challenge rewards.

🏆 Challenges

Press C (or the 🏆 button) to see the challenge board — start any challenge and claim coin rewards when you finish.
